⚔️ DeepSeek Harness cybersecurity red-team tool (dsh-purge)

Version 1.1.90

DeepSeek Harness jailbreak: every model, swap prompts per model. Default prompt for 小码酱. Please star ⭐ If you build on this, see Attribution required.


English | 中文 | 日本語

## A note from the maintainers dsh-purge was originally developed by its author as an independent project. It is now maintained by the **dsh-purge maintainers team**, which handles the codebase, documentation, releases, and security response. All historical commits, issues, and releases are preserved and links remain unchanged; the original author's credit and source record are retained. The project's boundaries remain unchanged: - **The open-source build includes everything sold as paid content.** The skill library and knowledge base ship with it; nothing is locked behind payment. - Penetration, attack, or scanning against mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau, banks and financial sites, government and military sites is prohibited. **About the paid content.** Everything the paid build includes is included in the open-source build. No feature or data in this repository requires payment to unlock; the skill library and knowledge base are part of the open-source release. **Resale of the original build is prohibited.** Paid resale, re-skinning for store listings, and distribution as a commercial product are not permitted. Forks and derivative work are allowed provided they credit the source repository: [HunYiSage/dsh-purge](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge). Removing the attribution, concealing the source, or presenting the project as one's own will be pursued by the maintainers. Third-party builds are not affiliated with the original author or this team; their maintainers are solely responsible for them. Official channels: this repository's [Issues](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/issues) and [Releases](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/releases), plus the team channel [t.me/LLM_PoJia](https://t.me/LLM_PoJia). They use look-alike names and avatars, run chat groups, charge or fundraise in the author's name, and spread the author's personal information. None of them are affiliated with the author or this team. > > **Known impersonation channels (examples, not a complete list):** on X, the account displayed as “叫我杨浩同学” with the handle `@yh2691983255`; on Telegram, the group named “【小码酱】技术圈交流群” at `t.me/dianhuaqun`, and accounts such as “二改破甲杨浩” that take orders and payments inside it. Impersonators can change names and avatars at any time. > > **Third-party modified builds (forks, repacks, rebrands) have no authorization or affiliation from the original author or this team.** Their code changes, fees, data handling, support and legal responsibility belong to their publishers. Using the author's name to sell them is impersonation. Forks must attribute and link back to this repository; resale of the original build is prohibited. > > The original author has reported the impersonation and personal-data leak to the police; the maintainers are cooperating fully and the evidence has been handed over. The author has also posted a statement on their own account. Out of respect for the author's privacy and the case itself, the police receipt and related screenshots are not published. > > **There are only two official channels:** this repository [HunYiSage/dsh-purge](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge) (Issues / Releases) and the team channel [t.me/LLM_PoJia](https://t.me/LLM_PoJia). No other channel, group, or account is run by the team; the team never charges, fundraises, or asks for personal information through personal accounts or DMs. The open-source build is free; commercial licensing goes through [LICENSE-COMMERCIAL.md](./LICENSE-COMMERCIAL.md). > > Do not send money to unofficial accounts, and do not reshare screenshots containing the author's personal information. Report impersonations to the platform. > > Thanks for supporting 小码酱. Stay safe. ## Contents - [A note from the maintainers](#a-note-from-the-maintainers) - [What this is](#what-this-is) - [Attribution required](#attribution-required) - [License](#license) - [Supported hosts](#supported-hosts) - [Install](#install) - [Preview](#preview) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Restore](#restore) - [Releases](#releases) --- ## What this is **dsh-purge** is a cybersecurity red-team plugin for the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) already installed on your machine. **1.1.90** targets **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** (0.2.0 still works). **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and newer RCs are not supported.** Official **Web** (`dsh web`) and the official **desktop EXE** are both supported. Install and Apply them separately. Harness does more than forward a prompt. It rewrites prompts, approval gates, sandbox policy, and session migration at runtime. Asking only “will the model answer” treats a host-layer block as a model refusal. This plugin separates those two layers on your own install, for controlled evaluation and for seeing which default policy is too tight. | You get | What it does | |---|---| | **dsh-purge dock** | A button beside the session title opens the right dock. Two pages: Clean and Drill | | **Clean** | Grouped patch status, Apply / Restore / Uninstall, prompt editor, multiple rule sets | | **Drill** | Built into the stable release. After authorization: assets and the local environment. The skill library and knowledge base ship with it. | | **Host policy** | Default copy, permission policy, and tool limits. Official capabilities stay. No second invented identity | | **On start** | Checks and reapplies. After npm overwrites `node_modules`, you do not hand-edit files | No hardcoded drive letters. It looks at `$DSH_HOME`, `.dsh` next to the dsh launcher, then `~/.dsh`. It does not patch the Harness source tree. **Apply** on the **Clean** page of **dsh-purge** is what writes the changes. Identity comes from the encrypted prompt shipped in the plugin, the text the prompt box shows by default. The host prompt file is not read. It only touches the official `@deepseek-ai` packages and local config on the user's machine. It is not a public scanner and not an attack kit for third-party sites. The repo does not ship malware, unauthorized-exploit scripts, or payloads aimed at the public internet. --- ## Resale of the original is prohibited. Forks must attribute. ## Attribution required **Resale of the original build is prohibited.** Paid resale, re-skinning for store listings, and distribution as a commercial product are not permitted. **Forks must attribute** and name the source repository: [HunYiSage/dsh-purge](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge). Same if you borrow the name, ideas, code, or prompts. Removing attribution, concealing the source, or reselling the original will be pursued by the maintainers. ## License This repo is [Apache License 2.0](./LICENSE). --- ## Supported hosts **1.1.81 and newer target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.** 0.2.0 still works. Do not apply it to 0.1.x. - **dsh 0.2.1-rc.2** (official desktop / official `dsh web`): use **1.1.81** or newer. Fixes `{{cwd}}` / `[cwd]` crash, patch #40 match, dropped `toolFilter`, host `dsh-tools` resolve, hostFs fd, desktop helper self-kill, `file:` archive update, Ctrl+Enter steer. - **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2**: use **1.1.40** or newer; this line also installs. - **dsh 0.1.7** (incl. rc.1 / rc.2): use **1.1.39** or older — pick the tag on [Releases](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/releases). - **dsh 0.2.1-rc.3 / rc.4 and newer are not supported.** Unmatched patches stay pending or skipped; nothing is rewritten blindly. Stay on **0.2.1-rc.2**. Unmatched patches stay pending or skipped; nothing is rewritten blindly. --- ## Install **Do not use the plugin marketplace.** One-click install on [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) or in Settings → Plugin Market fails with `already queued: dsh-purge` and never runs a command. The name is not on the npm registry, so do not `pnpm add dsh-purge`. ### Quick start Have `dsh` on PATH? One command, one restart, one click. Run the line for the host you open (the desktop EXE is the same with `desktop` instead of `web`): ```sh # Official `dsh web` dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master # Official desktop EXE dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` 1. **Fully quit and reopen** the host you installed into. Web: stop `dsh web` and start it again. Desktop: quit the tray icon too, then open the exe. 2. On that host, click **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Apply**. A successful Apply restarts the host once. Done — verify with `/purge status` in chat. If pnpm asks about build scripts, or anything below does not appear, follow the step by step. ### Step by step **Step 1 — Pick your host.** Official `dsh web` and the official desktop EXE are installed and patched **separately**; only install into the host you actually open. | What you run | Profile | Install command | |---|---|---| | Official `dsh web` | `web` | the `web` line in Quick start | | Official desktop EXE | `desktop` | the `desktop` line in Quick start | **Step 2 — Install the plugin.** Use the `codeload.github.com` URL exactly. Do not use `github.com/.../archive`: that 302 makes pnpm fail with `fetch failed`. Have `dsh`? Run the Quick start line for your profile. If this directory is already a clone, use `.` instead of the URL. pnpm only (no `dsh` required): run this inside the profile you actually use, not the repo root. ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" # desktop: profiles/desktop pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` Windows PowerShell: ```powershell cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web" # desktop: profiles\desktop pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` `pnpm add` and `dsh plugin add` fetch the package; `postinstall` writes `dsh-purge` into `dsh.profile.bundles` and adds a body `insert` in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`. Without that insert the host never loads the plugin and no button appears. **Expected result:** `node_modules/dsh-purge/package.json` exists, `"dsh-purge"` is in that profile's `bundles`, and `cordis.patch.yml` has an `id: dsh-purge` insert. - pnpm 11/12 skips install scripts (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`) unless you allow the build: ```sh pnpm add --allow-build=dsh-purge --allow-build=dsh-purge@https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master # Already installed, warning only — the full specifier is required (name-only leaves "set this to true or false"): pnpm approve-builds dsh-purge@https://codeload.github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master # If bundles / insert are still missing: node node_modules/dsh-purge/scripts/ensure-profile-bundle.mjs `
